events.title: MedTech Startup Pitch Competition
events.description: Amplify MedTech brings five MedTech startups together with founders, investors and the regional community for live pitches and networking. Presented with Menlo Park Patents. Pitching startups: BlueHealer, Liquet Medical Inc., Rubitection Inc., Salynt and WearableDose. See the official registration page for tickets and current event details.
events.location: 4MLK, 4 North Martin Luther King Junior Boulevard, Baltimore, MD 21201
